outcomes.item: Shared KAPLAY panel primitives now use a tighter visual rhythm: panel titles, eyebrow labels, divider rules, button spacing, and body text all come from the same palette/metric pass in `packages/kaplay-demo/src/theme-tokens.ts`, `packages/kaplay-demo/src/ui/atoms.ts`, `packages/kaplay-demo/src/shared.ts`, and `packages/kaplay-demo/src/panel-components.ts`.

Event and info text readability improved by using estimated wrapped text height instead of fixed single-line stepping, which prevents cramped or overlapping feed/info copy during longer room and narrative lines.

A lightweight KAPLAY capture workflow now exists in `packages/kaplay-demo/scripts/capture-ui.mjs` with operator notes in `packages/kaplay-demo/CAPTURE-WORKFLOW.md`; the deterministic `manifest.json` is the primary regression artifact, while PNG captures remain best-effort because headless canvas rendering can still flatten WebGL output on some environments.

follow-ups.item: The next critical lane is `50-12`: end-to-end Space Explorer chat-authoring verification and release-readiness closure.
If headless browser GPU support becomes more reliable later, upgrade the capture workflow so the PNG outputs can become true golden-image artifacts instead of optional sidecars.
